panels.title: Cost by model (actual $ per interval, not extrapolated)
panels.description: Each point is real dollars accrued in that interval (increase(), not rate()*3600) so totals stay accurate at any zoom level. Includes cache write (1.25x) / cache read (0.1x) pricing.

panels.title: Escalation ladder: stage_router decisions/sec by selected model
panels.description: stage_router decisions only, broken out by selected_model so the two escalation targets are distinguishable: claude-opus-5 escalations (smart, front_door) vs claude-fable-5-1 escalations (smart_sonnet_fable from sonnet-5, capable_escalate from opus-5). Metrics are labelled by model, not by route: stage_router + claude-opus-5 mixes smart/front_door escalations with capable_escalate's default pick, and these cannot be separated. Per-algorithm x selected_model decision counts are the closest available proxy for per-route activity.
